billing_adjustment_quantities_check.name: billing_adjustment_quantities_check
billing_adjustment_quantities_check.value: "billing_adjustment"."source_credits" >= 0 AND "billing_adjustment"."remaining_credits" >= 0 AND "billing_adjustment"."reserved_credits" >= 0 AND "billing_adjustment"."consumed_credits" >= 0 AND "billing_adjustment"."revoked_credits" >= 0 AND "billing_adjustment"."unrecoverable_credits" >= 0 AND "billing_adjustment"."revoked_credits" = ("billing_adjustment"."remaining_credits" + "billing_adjustment"."reserved_credits") AND "billing_adjustment"."consumed_credits" <= "billing_adjustment"."unrecoverable_credits" AND ("billing_adjustment"."revoked_credits" + "billing_adjustment"."unrecoverable_credits") <= "billing_adjustment"."source_credits"

billing_payment_state_quantities_check.name: billing_payment_state_quantities_check
billing_payment_state_quantities_check.value: "billing_payment_state"."source_credits" >= 0 AND "billing_payment_state"."target_credits" >= 0 AND "billing_payment_state"."target_credits" <= "billing_payment_state"."source_credits" AND "billing_payment_state"."revoked_credits" >= 0 AND "billing_payment_state"."unrecoverable_credits" >= 0 AND "billing_payment_state"."consumed_credits" >= 0 AND "billing_payment_state"."revoked_credits" + "billing_payment_state"."unrecoverable_credits" = "billing_payment_state"."target_credits" AND "billing_payment_state"."consumed_credits" <= "billing_payment_state"."unrecoverable_credits" AND "billing_payment_state"."version" >= 1

contact_submission_name_bounds_check.name: contact_submission_name_bounds_check
contact_submission_name_bounds_check.value: "contact_submission"."name" = btrim("contact_submission"."name") AND char_length("contact_submission"."name") BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND octet_length("contact_submission"."name") <= 400 AND "contact_submission"."name" !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'

contact_submission_email_bounds_check.name: contact_submission_email_bounds_check
contact_submission_email_bounds_check.value: "contact_submission"."email" = btrim("contact_submission"."email") AND "contact_submission"."email" = lower("contact_submission"."email") AND char_length("contact_submission"."email") BETWEEN 3 AND 320 AND octet_length("contact_submission"."email") <= 320 AND position('@' IN "contact_submission"."email") > 1 AND "contact_submission"."email" !~ '[[:cntrl:][:space:]]'

contact_submission_subject_bounds_check.name: contact_submission_subject_bounds_check
contact_submission_subject_bounds_check.value: "contact_submission"."subject" = btrim("contact_submission"."subject") AND char_length("contact_submission"."subject") BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND octet_length("contact_submission"."subject") <= 800 AND "contact_submission"."subject" !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'

contact_submission_message_bounds_check.name: contact_submission_message_bounds_check
contact_submission_message_bounds_check.value: "contact_submission"."message" = btrim("contact_submission"."message") AND char_length("contact_submission"."message") BETWEEN 10 AND 5000 AND octet_length("contact_submission"."message") <= 20000 AND regexp_replace("contact_submission"."message", E'[\t\n\r]', '', 'g') !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'

credit_reservation_start_contract_shape_.name: credit_reservation_start_contract_shape_check
credit_reservation_start_contract_shape_.value:
(
        "credit_reservation"."start_contract_version" = 0 AND
        "credit_reservation"."start_attempt_id" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "credit_reservation"."start_contract_version" = 1 AND
        "credit_reservation"."session_id" IS NOT NULL AND
        "credit_reservation"."start_attempt_id" IS NOT NULL AND
        "credit_reservation"."session_id" = "credit_reservation"."start_attempt_id" AND
        "credit_reservation"."reservation_key" =
          'interview-start:' || "credit_reservation"."user_id"::text || ':' ||
          "credit_reservation"."start_attempt_id"::text
      )

feedback_version_tuple_check.name: feedback_version_tuple_check
feedback_version_tuple_check.value:
(
        "feedback"."schema_version" IS NULL AND
        "feedback"."prompt_version" IS NULL AND
        "feedback"."model_version" IS NULL AND
        "feedback"."evaluation_state" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "feedback"."schema_version" IS NOT NULL AND
        "feedback"."prompt_version" IS NOT NULL AND
        "feedback"."model_version" IS NOT NULL AND
        "feedback"."evaluation_state" IS NOT NULL AND
        (
          (
            "feedback"."schema_version" = 'feedback.v2' AND
            "feedback"."prompt_version" = 'feedback.prompt.v2' AND
            "feedback"."rubric_version" = 'pm-feedback-rubric.v2' AND
            "feedback"."evaluation_state" IN ('full', 'partial')
          ) OR
          (
            "feedback"."schema_version" = 'feedback.evidence-limited.v2' AND
            "feedback"."prompt_version" = 'feedback.prompt.evidence-limited.v2' AND
            "feedback"."rubric_version" = 'pm-feedback-rubric.v2' AND
            "feedback"."evaluation_state" = 'partial'
          ) OR
          (
            "feedback"."schema_version" = 'feedback.dimension-coverage.v1' AND
            "feedback"."prompt_version" = 'feedback.prompt.dimension-coverage.v1' AND
            "feedback"."rubric_version" = 'pm-feedback-rubric.v3' AND
            "feedback"."evaluation_state" IN ('full', 'partial')
          ) OR
          (
            "feedback"."schema_version" = 'feedback.dimension-coverage.v2' AND
            "feedback"."prompt_version" = 'feedback.prompt.dimension-coverage.v1' AND
            "feedback"."rubric_version" = 'pm-feedback-rubric.v3' AND
            "feedback"."evaluation_state" IN ('full', 'partial')
          )
        ) AND
        length(trim("feedback"."model_version")) > 0
      )

feedback_dimension_coverage_tuple_check.name: feedback_dimension_coverage_tuple_check
feedback_dimension_coverage_tuple_check.value:
(
        "feedback"."schema_version" IS DISTINCT FROM 'feedback.dimension-coverage.v1' AND
        "feedback"."schema_version" IS DISTINCT FROM 'feedback.dimension-coverage.v2' AND
        "feedback"."feedback_mode" IS NULL AND
        "feedback"."feedback_round_type" IS NULL AND
        "feedback"."dimension_coverage" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "feedback"."schema_version" IN ('feedback.dimension-coverage.v1', 'feedback.dimension-coverage.v2') AND
        "feedback"."feedback_mode" IN ('full_scorecard', 'partial_scorecard', 'coaching_review') AND
        "feedback"."feedback_round_type" IN ('product_sense', 'execution', 'behavioral', 'strategy') AND
        "feedback"."dimension_coverage" IS NOT NULL AND
        "feedback"."rubric_version" = 'pm-feedback-rubric.v3'
      )

feedback_verified_prefix_scope_tuple_che.name: feedback_verified_prefix_scope_tuple_check
feedback_verified_prefix_scope_tuple_che.value:
(
        "feedback"."schema_version" IS DISTINCT FROM 'feedback.dimension-coverage.v2' AND
        "feedback"."verified_prefix_scope" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "feedback"."schema_version" = 'feedback.dimension-coverage.v2' AND
        (
          (
            "feedback"."feedback_mode" = 'full_scorecard' AND
            "feedback"."evaluation_state" = 'full' AND
            "feedback"."overall_score" IS NOT NULL AND
            "feedback"."verified_prefix_scope"->>'excludedTailBlockCount' = '0'
          ) OR (
            "feedback"."feedback_mode" IN ('partial_scorecard', 'coaching_review') AND
            "feedback"."evaluation_state" = 'partial' AND
            "feedback"."overall_score" IS NULL
          )
        ) AND
        "feedback"."verified_prefix_scope" IS NOT NULL AND
        CASE
          WHEN jsonb_typeof("feedback"."verified_prefix_scope") IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'object' THEN
            "feedback"."verified_prefix_scope"->>'contractVersion' IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'feedback.verified-prefix-scope.v1' AND
            "feedback"."verified_prefix_scope"->>'projectionVersion' IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'trusted-answer-block-projection.v1' AND
            CASE
              WHEN jsonb_typeof("feedback"."verified_prefix_scope"->'trustedBlockIdentities') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'array' THEN
                jsonb_array_length("feedback"."verified_prefix_scope"->'trustedBlockIdentities') BETWEEN 1 AND 1000
              ELSE false
            END AND
            jsonb_typeof("feedback"."verified_prefix_scope"->'excludedTailBlockCount') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'number' AND
            CASE
              WHEN "feedback"."verified_prefix_scope"->>'excludedTailBlockCount' ~ '^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,3})$' THEN
                ("feedback"."verified_prefix_scope"->>'excludedTailBlockCount')::integer BETWEEN 0 AND 1000
              ELSE false
            END AND
            ("feedback"."verified_prefix_scope" - 'contractVersion' - 'projectionVersion' - 'trustedBlockIdentities' - 'excludedTailBlockCount') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM '{}'::jsonb AND
            octet_length("feedback"."verified_prefix_scope"::text) <= 128000
          ELSE false
        END
      )

feedback_dimension_coverage_score_tuple_.name: feedback_dimension_coverage_score_tuple_check
feedback_dimension_coverage_score_tuple_.value:
"feedback"."schema_version" NOT IN ('feedback.dimension-coverage.v1', 'feedback.dimension-coverage.v2') OR (
        (
          "feedback"."feedback_mode" = 'full_scorecard' AND
          "feedback"."structure_score" IS NOT NULL AND
          "feedback"."clarity_score" IS NOT NULL AND
          "feedback"."insight_score" IS NOT NULL AND
          "feedback"."communication_score" IS NOT NULL AND
          "feedback"."leadership_score" IS NOT NULL AND
          "feedback"."overall_score" IS NOT NULL
        ) OR (
          "feedback"."feedback_mode" = 'partial_scorecard' AND
          "feedback"."overall_score" IS NULL
        ) OR (
          "feedback"."feedback_mode" = 'coaching_review' AND
          "feedback"."structure_score" IS NULL AND
          "feedback"."clarity_score" IS NULL AND
          "feedback"."insight_score" IS NULL AND
          "feedback"."communication_score" IS NULL AND
          "feedback"."leadership_score" IS NULL AND
          "feedback"."overall_score" IS NULL
        )
      )

feedback_dispatch_event_required_check.name: feedback_dispatch_event_required_check
feedback_dispatch_event_required_check.value: ("feedback"."dispatch_status" = 'not_required' AND "feedback"."dispatch_event_id" IS NULL) OR ("feedback"."dispatch_status" <> 'not_required' AND "feedback"."dispatch_event_id" IS NOT NULL)

feedback_generation_stage_attempt_operat.name: feedback_generation_stage_attempt_operation_stage_check

feedback_generation_stage_attempt_provid.name: feedback_generation_stage_attempt_provider_attempt_check

feedback_generation_stage_attempt_outcom.name: feedback_generation_stage_attempt_outcome_failure_check

feedback_generation_stage_attempt_timing.name: feedback_generation_stage_attempt_timing_check
feedback_generation_stage_attempt_timing.value: "feedback_generation_stage_attempt"."completed_at" = "feedback_generation_stage_attempt"."started_at" + ("feedback_generation_stage_attempt"."duration_ms" * INTERVAL '1 millisecond') AND "feedback_generation_stage_attempt"."duration_ms" BETWEEN 0 AND 90000 AND "feedback_generation_stage_attempt"."remaining_budget_ms" BETWEEN 0 AND 90000 AND ("feedback_generation_stage_attempt"."retry_after_ms" IS NULL OR "feedback_generation_stage_attempt"."retry_after_ms" BETWEEN 0 AND 90000)

feedback_generation_stage_attempt_durati.name: feedback_generation_stage_attempt_duration_bucket_check

feedback_generation_stage_attempt_provid.name: feedback_generation_stage_attempt_provider_context_check
feedback_generation_stage_attempt_provid.value:
(
        "feedback_generation_stage_attempt"."operation" NOT IN ('provider_request', 'provider_response') AND
        "feedback_generation_stage_attempt"."retry_after_ms" IS NULL AND
        "feedback_generation_stage_attempt"."provider_diagnostic_kind" IS NULL AND
        "feedback_generation_stage_attempt"."provider_http_status" IS NULL AND
        "feedback_generation_stage_attempt"."observed_model" IS NULL AND
        "feedback_generation_stage_attempt"."observed_service_tier" IS NULL AND
        "feedback_generation_stage_attempt"."input_tokens" IS NULL AND
        "feedback_generation_stage_attempt"."cached_input_tokens" IS NULL AND
        "feedback_generation_stage_attempt"."output_tokens" IS NULL AND
        "feedback_generation_stage_attempt"."total_tokens" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "feedback_generation_stage_attempt"."operation" = 'provider_request' AND
        ("feedback_generation_stage_attempt"."provider_http_status" IS NULL OR "feedback_generation_stage_attempt"."provider_diagnostic_kind" IS NOT NULL) AND
        ("feedback_generation_stage_attempt"."retry_after_ms" IS NULL OR "feedback_generation_stage_attempt"."outcome" = 'retrying')
      ) OR (
        "feedback_generation_stage_attempt"."operation" = 'provider_response' AND
        "feedback_generation_stage_attempt"."retry_after_ms" IS NULL AND
        ("feedback_generation_stage_attempt"."provider_http_status" IS NULL OR "feedback_generation_stage_attempt"."provider_diagnostic_kind" IS NOT NULL)
      )

feedback_generation_stage_attempt_provid.name: feedback_generation_stage_attempt_provider_label_check
feedback_generation_stage_attempt_provid.value: ("feedback_generation_stage_attempt"."observed_model" IS NULL OR "feedback_generation_stage_attempt"."observed_model" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{0,95}$') AND ("feedback_generation_stage_attempt"."observed_service_tier" IS NULL OR "feedback_generation_stage_attempt"."observed_service_tier" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{0,95}$')

feedback_generation_stage_attempt_usage_.name: feedback_generation_stage_attempt_usage_tuple_check
feedback_generation_stage_attempt_usage_.value:
(
        "feedback_generation_stage_attempt"."input_tokens" IS NULL AND "feedback_generation_stage_attempt"."cached_input_tokens" IS NULL AND "feedback_generation_stage_attempt"."output_tokens" IS NULL AND "feedback_generation_stage_attempt"."total_tokens" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "feedback_generation_stage_attempt"."input_tokens" BETWEEN 0 AND 10000000 AND
        "feedback_generation_stage_attempt"."cached_input_tokens" BETWEEN 0 AND 10000000 AND
        "feedback_generation_stage_attempt"."output_tokens" BETWEEN 0 AND 10000000 AND
        "feedback_generation_stage_attempt"."total_tokens" BETWEEN 0 AND 10000000
      )

feedback_quality_signal_selection_check.name: feedback_quality_signal_selection_check

focused_practice_attempt_plan_version_ch.name: focused_practice_attempt_plan_version_check
focused_practice_attempt_plan_version_ch.value:
((
          "focused_practice_attempt"."contract_version" = 'focused-practice-attempt.v1' AND
          "focused_practice_attempt"."plan_contract_version" = 'focused-practice-plan.v1' AND
          "focused_practice_attempt"."plan_template_version" = 'focused-practice-templates.v1'
        ) OR (
          "focused_practice_attempt"."contract_version" = 'focused-practice-attempt.v2' AND
          "focused_practice_attempt"."plan_contract_version" = 'focused-practice-plan.v2' AND
          "focused_practice_attempt"."plan_template_version" = 'focused-practice-templates.v2'
        )) AND length(trim("focused_practice_attempt"."plan_template_id")) > 0

focused_practice_attempt_snapshot_versio.name: focused_practice_attempt_snapshot_version_check
focused_practice_attempt_snapshot_versio.value:
jsonb_typeof("focused_practice_attempt"."feedback_version") = 'object' AND (
        (
          "focused_practice_attempt"."contract_version" = 'focused-practice-attempt.v1' AND
          "focused_practice_attempt"."feedback_version"->>'schemaVersion' = 'feedback.v2' AND
          "focused_practice_attempt"."feedback_version"->>'promptVersion' = 'feedback.prompt.v2' AND
          "focused_practice_attempt"."feedback_version"->>'rubricVersion' = 'pm-feedback-rubric.v2' AND
          "focused_practice_attempt"."feedback_version"->>'evaluationState' IN ('full', 'partial')
        ) OR (
          "focused_practice_attempt"."contract_version" = 'focused-practice-attempt.v2' AND
          "focused_practice_attempt"."feedback_version"->>'schemaVersion' = 'feedback.evidence-limited.v2' AND
          "focused_practice_attempt"."feedback_version"->>'promptVersion' = 'feedback.prompt.evidence-limited.v2' AND
          "focused_practice_attempt"."feedback_version"->>'rubricVersion' = 'pm-feedback-rubric.v2' AND
          "focused_practice_attempt"."feedback_version"->>'evaluationState' = 'partial' AND
          "focused_practice_attempt"."feedback_version"->>'reviewOutcome' = 'coaching_review' AND
          "focused_practice_attempt"."feedback_version"->>'scoreWithheldReason' IN ('rubric_coverage', 'verified_evidence_integrity') AND
          "focused_practice_attempt"."feedback_version"->>'sourceFingerprint' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
        ) OR (
          "focused_practice_attempt"."contract_version" = 'focused-practice-attempt.v2' AND
          "focused_practice_attempt"."feedback_version"->>'schemaVersion' IN ('feedback.dimension-coverage.v1', 'feedback.dimension-coverage.v2') AND
          "focused_practice_attempt"."feedback_version"->>'promptVersion' = 'feedback.prompt.dimension-coverage.v1' AND
          "focused_practice_attempt"."feedback_version"->>'rubricVersion' = 'pm-feedback-rubric.v3' AND
          "focused_practice_attempt"."feedback_version"->>'evaluationState' = 'partial' AND
          "focused_practice_attempt"."feedback_version"->>'reviewOutcome' IN ('partial_scorecard', 'coaching_review') AND
          "focused_practice_attempt"."feedback_version"->>'scoreWithheldReason' IN ('rubric_coverage', 'verified_evidence_integrity') AND
          ("focused_practice_attempt"."feedback_version"->>'reviewOutcome' <> 'partial_scorecard' OR "focused_practice_attempt"."feedback_version"->>'scoreWithheldReason' = 'rubric_coverage') AND
          "focused_practice_attempt"."feedback_version"->>'sourceFingerprint' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
        )
      ) AND
        jsonb_typeof("focused_practice_attempt"."plan") = 'object' AND
        "focused_practice_attempt"."plan"->>'state' = 'available' AND
        "focused_practice_attempt"."plan"->>'contractVersion' = "focused_practice_attempt"."plan_contract_version" AND
        "focused_practice_attempt"."plan"->>'templateVersion' = "focused_practice_attempt"."plan_template_version" AND
        "focused_practice_attempt"."plan"->>'templateId' = "focused_practice_attempt"."plan_template_id" AND
        jsonb_typeof("focused_practice_attempt"."source_finding") = 'object' AND
        (
          "focused_practice_attempt"."contract_version" = 'focused-practice-attempt.v1' OR (
            "focused_practice_attempt"."source_finding"->>'kind' IN ('evidence_limited_improvement', 'dimension_coverage_focus') AND
            "focused_practice_attempt"."plan"#>>'{source,focusIdentity,kind}' = "focused_practice_attempt"."source_finding"->>'kind' AND
            (
              ("focused_practice_attempt"."feedback_version"->>'schemaVersion' = 'feedback.evidence-limited.v2' AND "focused_practice_attempt"."source_finding"->>'kind' = 'evidence_limited_improvement') OR
              ("focused_practice_attempt"."feedback_version"->>'schemaVersion' IN ('feedback.dimension-coverage.v1', 'feedback.dimension-coverage.v2') AND "focused_practice_attempt"."source_finding"->>'kind' = 'dimension_coverage_focus')
            )
          )
        ) AND
        octet_length("focused_practice_attempt"."feedback_version"::text) <= 65536 AND
        octet_length("focused_practice_attempt"."plan"::text) <= 65536 AND
        octet_length("focused_practice_attempt"."source_finding"::text) <= 65536 AND
        ("focused_practice_attempt"."completion" IS NULL OR (jsonb_typeof("focused_practice_attempt"."completion") = 'object' AND octet_length("focused_practice_attempt"."completion"::text) <= 65536))

focused_practice_attempt_lifecycle_check.name: focused_practice_attempt_lifecycle_check
focused_practice_attempt_lifecycle_check.value:
(
        "focused_practice_attempt"."state" = 'in_progress' AND
        "focused_practice_attempt"."lifecycle_version" = 0 AND
        "focused_practice_attempt"."completed_at" IS NULL AND
        "focused_practice_attempt"."completion" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "focused_practice_attempt"."state" = 'completed' AND
        "focused_practice_attempt"."lifecycle_version" = 1 AND
        "focused_practice_attempt"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND
        "focused_practice_attempt"."completed_at" >= "focused_practice_attempt"."started_at" AND
        "focused_practice_attempt"."completion" IS NOT NULL
      )

interview_session_start_contract_shape_c.name: interview_session_start_contract_shape_check
interview_session_start_contract_shape_c.value:
(
        "interview_session"."start_contract_version" = 0 AND
        "interview_session"."start_attempt_id" IS NULL AND
        "interview_session"."start_request_fingerprint" IS NULL AND
        "interview_session"."provisioning_state" = 'legacy' AND
        "interview_session"."provisioning_lease_id" IS NULL AND
        "interview_session"."provisioning_lease_expires_at" IS NULL AND
        "interview_session"."provisioned_at" IS NULL AND
        "interview_session"."usable_at" IS NULL AND
        "interview_session"."usable_transcript_event_id" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "interview_session"."start_contract_version" = 1 AND
        "interview_session"."start_attempt_id" IS NOT NULL AND
        "interview_session"."id" = "interview_session"."start_attempt_id" AND
        "interview_session"."start_request_fingerprint" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND
        "interview_session"."livekit_room_name" = 'interview-' || "interview_session"."start_attempt_id"::text AND
        "interview_session"."provisioning_state" IN ('pending', 'provisioning', 'ready', 'failed')
      )

interview_session_provisioning_evidence_.name: interview_session_provisioning_evidence_check
interview_session_provisioning_evidence_.value:
CASE "interview_session"."provisioning_state"
        WHEN 'legacy' THEN
          "interview_session"."provisioning_lease_id" IS NULL AND
          "interview_session"."provisioning_lease_expires_at" IS NULL AND
          "interview_session"."provisioned_at" IS NULL
        WHEN 'pending' THEN
          "interview_session"."provisioning_lease_id" IS NULL AND
          "interview_session"."provisioning_lease_expires_at" IS NULL AND
          "interview_session"."provisioned_at" IS NULL
        WHEN 'provisioning' THEN
          "interview_session"."provisioning_lease_id" IS NOT NULL AND
          "interview_session"."provisioning_lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL AND
          "interview_session"."provisioned_at" IS NULL
        WHEN 'ready' THEN
          "interview_session"."provisioning_lease_id" IS NULL AND
          "interview_session"."provisioning_lease_expires_at" IS NULL AND
          "interview_session"."provisioned_at" IS NOT NULL
        WHEN 'failed' THEN
          "interview_session"."provisioning_lease_id" IS NULL AND
          "interview_session"."provisioning_lease_expires_at" IS NULL AND
          "interview_session"."provisioned_at" IS NULL
        ELSE false
      END

interview_session_usable_evidence_check.name: interview_session_usable_evidence_check
interview_session_usable_evidence_check.value:
(
        "interview_session"."usable_at" IS NULL AND
        "interview_session"."usable_transcript_event_id" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "interview_session"."start_contract_version" = 1 AND
        "interview_session"."activated_at" IS NOT NULL AND
        "interview_session"."usable_at" IS NOT NULL AND
        "interview_session"."usable_transcript_event_id" IS NOT NULL AND
        length("interview_session"."usable_transcript_event_id") > 0
      )

interview_session_billing_fault_shape_ch.name: interview_session_billing_fault_shape_check
interview_session_billing_fault_shape_ch.value:
(
        "interview_session"."start_contract_version" = 0 AND
        "interview_session"."billing_fault" IS NULL AND
        "interview_session"."billing_fault_code" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "interview_session"."lifecycle_state" IN ('completed', 'abandoned', 'failed') AND
        "interview_session"."billing_fault" IN ('user', 'provider', 'integrity') AND
        "interview_session"."billing_fault_code" ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_.-]{0,63}$'
      ) OR (
        "interview_session"."lifecycle_state" = 'ending' AND (
          ("interview_session"."billing_fault" IS NULL AND "interview_session"."billing_fault_code" IS NULL) OR
          ("interview_session"."billing_fault" IN ('user', 'provider', 'integrity') AND
            "interview_session"."billing_fault_code" ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_.-]{0,63}$')
        )
      ) OR (
        "interview_session"."lifecycle_state" NOT IN ('ending', 'completed', 'abandoned', 'failed') AND
        "interview_session"."billing_fault" IS NULL AND
        "interview_session"."billing_fault_code" IS NULL
      )

interview_session_runtime_failure_shape_.name: interview_session_runtime_failure_shape_check
interview_session_runtime_failure_shape_.value:
(
        "interview_session"."runtime_failure_event_id" IS NULL AND
        "interview_session"."runtime_failure_code" IS NULL AND
        "interview_session"."runtime_failure_retryable" IS NULL AND
        "interview_session"."runtime_failed_at" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "interview_session"."start_contract_version" = 1 AND
        "interview_session"."billing_fault" = 'provider' AND
        length("interview_session"."runtime_failure_event_id") > 0 AND
        "interview_session"."runtime_failure_code" = "interview_session"."billing_fault_code" AND
        "interview_session"."runtime_failure_code" ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_.-]{0,63}$' AND
        "interview_session"."runtime_failure_retryable" IS NOT NULL AND
        "interview_session"."runtime_failed_at" IS NOT NULL
      )

interview_session_credit_settlement_shap.name: interview_session_credit_settlement_shape_check
interview_session_credit_settlement_shap.value:
(
        "interview_session"."credit_policy_version" IS NULL AND
        "interview_session"."credit_settlement_action" IS NULL AND
        "interview_session"."credit_settlement_reason" IS NULL AND
        "interview_session"."credit_settlement_idempotency_key" IS NULL AND
        "interview_session"."credit_settled_at" IS NULL AND
        "interview_session"."credit_make_good_grant_id" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "interview_session"."start_contract_version" = 1 AND
        "interview_session"."lifecycle_state" IN ('completed', 'abandoned', 'failed') AND
        "interview_session"."billing_fault" IS NOT NULL AND
        "interview_session"."credit_policy_version" = 'interview-credit-recovery.v1' AND
        "interview_session"."credit_settlement_action" IN ('release', 'refund', 'retain') AND
        "interview_session"."credit_settlement_reason" IN (
          'terminal_before_usable',
          'provider_failure_after_usable',
          'integrity_failure_after_usable',
          'user_outcome_after_usable'
        ) AND
        length("interview_session"."credit_settlement_idempotency_key") > 0 AND
        "interview_session"."credit_settled_at" IS NOT NULL AND
        ("interview_session"."credit_make_good_grant_id" IS NULL OR
          "interview_session"."credit_settlement_action" = 'refund')
      )

interview_session_credit_settlement_poli.name: interview_session_credit_settlement_policy_check
interview_session_credit_settlement_poli.value:
"interview_session"."credit_settlement_action" IS NULL OR
        ("interview_session"."credit_settlement_action" = 'release' AND
          "interview_session"."credit_settlement_reason" = 'terminal_before_usable') OR
        ("interview_session"."credit_settlement_action" = 'refund' AND
          "interview_session"."billing_fault" = 'provider' AND
          "interview_session"."credit_settlement_reason" = 'provider_failure_after_usable') OR
        ("interview_session"."credit_settlement_action" = 'refund' AND
          "interview_session"."billing_fault" = 'integrity' AND
          "interview_session"."credit_settlement_reason" = 'integrity_failure_after_usable') OR
        ("interview_session"."credit_settlement_action" = 'retain' AND
          "interview_session"."billing_fault" = 'user' AND
          "interview_session"."credit_settlement_reason" = 'user_outcome_after_usable')

interview_session_terminal_reason_state_.name: interview_session_terminal_reason_state_check
interview_session_terminal_reason_state_.value: ("interview_session"."lifecycle_state" IN ('ending', 'completed', 'abandoned', 'failed') AND "interview_session"."terminal_reason" IS NOT NULL) OR ("interview_session"."lifecycle_state" NOT IN ('ending', 'completed', 'abandoned', 'failed') AND "interview_session"."terminal_reason" IS NULL)

interview_session_transcript_evidence_sh.name: interview_session_transcript_evidence_shape_check
interview_session_transcript_evidence_sh.value:
(
        "interview_session"."transcript_evidence_version" IS NULL AND
        "interview_session"."transcript_evidence_state" IS NULL AND
        "interview_session"."transcript_cutoff_at" IS NULL AND
        "interview_session"."transcript_evidence_frozen_at" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "interview_session"."transcript_evidence_version" = 1 AND
        "interview_session"."transcript_evidence_state" IN ('complete', 'partial', 'insufficient', 'degraded') AND
        "interview_session"."transcript_cutoff_at" IS NOT NULL AND
        "interview_session"."transcript_evidence_frozen_at" IS NOT NULL AND
        "interview_session"."lifecycle_state" IN ('completed', 'abandoned', 'failed')
      )

interview_session_room_provisioning_clai.name: interview_session_room_provisioning_claim_check
interview_session_room_provisioning_clai.value: ("interview_session"."room_provisioning_pending" AND "interview_session"."room_provisioning_started_at" IS NOT NULL) OR (NOT "interview_session"."room_provisioning_pending" AND "interview_session"."room_provisioning_started_at" IS NULL)

interview_session_reconnect_deadline_own.name: interview_session_reconnect_deadline_owner_check
interview_session_reconnect_deadline_own.value: ("interview_session"."reconnect_deadline_at" IS NULL AND "interview_session"."reconnect_deadline_owner" IS NULL) OR ("interview_session"."reconnect_deadline_at" IS NOT NULL AND "interview_session"."reconnect_deadline_owner" IN ('reconnect_grace', 'hard_deadline'))

interview_session_deadline_room_cleanup_.name: interview_session_deadline_room_cleanup_ack_check
interview_session_deadline_room_cleanup_.value: ("interview_session"."deadline_room_cleanup_status" IN ('deleted', 'already_absent') AND "interview_session"."deadline_room_cleanup_acknowledged_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("interview_session"."deadline_room_cleanup_status" IS NULL OR "interview_session"."deadline_room_cleanup_status" = 'pending') AND "interview_session"."deadline_room_cleanup_acknowledged_at" IS NULL

public_demo_session_recovery_claim_check.name: public_demo_session_recovery_claim_check
public_demo_session_recovery_claim_check.value: ("public_demo_session"."recovery_claim_token" IS NULL AND "public_demo_session"."recovery_finalized_at" IS NULL) OR ("public_demo_session"."status" = 'ready' AND "public_demo_session"."token_issues" = 2 AND ("public_demo_session"."recovery_finalized_at" IS NULL OR "public_demo_session"."recovery_claim_token" IS NOT NULL))

session_question_start_contract_shape_ch.name: session_question_start_contract_shape_check
session_question_start_contract_shape_ch.value:
(
        "session_question"."start_contract_version" = 0 AND
        "session_question"."start_attempt_id" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "session_question"."start_contract_version" = 1 AND
        "session_question"."start_attempt_id" IS NOT NULL AND
        "session_question"."session_id" = "session_question"."start_attempt_id"
      )

shadow_feedback_artifact_shape_check.name: shadow_feedback_artifact_shape_check
shadow_feedback_artifact_shape_check.value: jsonb_typeof("shadow_feedback_artifact"."artifact") = 'object' AND "shadow_feedback_artifact"."artifact"->>'contractVersion' = "shadow_feedback_artifact"."artifact_contract_version" AND jsonb_typeof("shadow_feedback_artifact"."artifact"->'key') = 'object' AND "shadow_feedback_artifact"."artifact"#>>'{key,contractVersion}' = "shadow_feedback_artifact"."key_contract_version" AND "shadow_feedback_artifact"."artifact"#>>'{key,keyFingerprint}' = "shadow_feedback_artifact"."artifact_key_fingerprint" AND "shadow_feedback_artifact"."artifact"#>>'{key,sessionId}' = "shadow_feedback_artifact"."session_id"::text AND "shadow_feedback_artifact"."artifact"#>>'{key,trustedBlockFingerprint}' = "shadow_feedback_artifact"."trusted_block_fingerprint" AND "shadow_feedback_artifact"."artifact"#>>'{key,rubricVersion}' = "shadow_feedback_artifact"."rubric_version" AND "shadow_feedback_artifact"."artifact"#>>'{key,promptVersion}' = "shadow_feedback_artifact"."prompt_version" AND "shadow_feedback_artifact"."artifact"#>>'{key,selectionSchemaVersion}' = "shadow_feedback_artifact"."selection_schema_version" AND "shadow_feedback_artifact"."artifact"#>>'{key,modelVersion}' = "shadow_feedback_artifact"."model_version" AND jsonb_typeof("shadow_feedback_artifact"."artifact"->'outcome') = 'object' AND jsonb_typeof("shadow_feedback_artifact"."artifact"->'metrics') = 'object' AND octet_length("shadow_feedback_artifact"."artifact"::text) <= 64000

transcript_evidence_writer_cutoff_progre.name: transcript_evidence_writer_cutoff_progress_boundary_check
transcript_evidence_writer_cutoff_progre.value:
(
        "transcript_evidence_writer_cutoff"."committed_sequence" = 0 AND
        "transcript_evidence_writer_cutoff"."committed_event_id" IS NULL AND
        "transcript_evidence_writer_cutoff"."committed_through_at" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "transcript_evidence_writer_cutoff"."committed_sequence" > 0 AND
        "transcript_evidence_writer_cutoff"."committed_event_id" IS NOT NULL AND
        "transcript_evidence_writer_cutoff"."committed_through_at" IS NOT NULL
      )

transcript_runtime_settlement_command_te.name: transcript_runtime_settlement_command_terminal_shape_check
transcript_runtime_settlement_command_te.value:
(
        "transcript_runtime_settlement_command"."state" = 'pending' AND
        "transcript_runtime_settlement_command"."terminal_reason" IS NULL AND
        "transcript_runtime_settlement_command"."acknowledged_at" IS NULL AND
        "transcript_runtime_settlement_command"."terminal_at" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "transcript_runtime_settlement_command"."state" = 'acknowledged' AND
        "transcript_runtime_settlement_command"."terminal_reason" IN ('settled', 'degraded') AND
        "transcript_runtime_settlement_command"."acknowledged_at" IS NOT NULL AND
        "transcript_runtime_settlement_command"."terminal_at" IS NOT NULL
      ) OR (
        "transcript_runtime_settlement_command"."state" = 'terminal' AND
        "transcript_runtime_settlement_command"."terminal_reason" IN ('expired', 'fenced', 'unavailable') AND
        "transcript_runtime_settlement_command"."acknowledged_at" IS NULL AND
        "transcript_runtime_settlement_command"."terminal_at" IS NOT NULL
      )

transcript_runtime_writer_progress_bound.name: transcript_runtime_writer_progress_boundary_check
transcript_runtime_writer_progress_bound.value:
(
        "transcript_runtime_writer"."committed_sequence" = 0 AND
        "transcript_runtime_writer"."committed_event_id" IS NULL AND
        "transcript_runtime_writer"."committed_through_at" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "transcript_runtime_writer"."committed_sequence" > 0 AND
        "transcript_runtime_writer"."committed_event_id" IS NOT NULL AND
        "transcript_runtime_writer"."committed_through_at" IS NOT NULL
      )

transcript_turn_session_writer_sequence_.name: transcript_turn_session_writer_sequence_idx
transcript_turn_session_writer_sequence_.where: "transcript_turn"."writer_id" IS NOT NULL AND "transcript_turn"."sequence" IS NOT NULL

transcript_turn_canonical_identity_check.name: transcript_turn_canonical_identity_check
transcript_turn_canonical_identity_check.value:
(
        "transcript_turn"."contract_version" IS NULL AND
        "transcript_turn"."event_id" IS NULL AND
        "transcript_turn"."writer_id" IS NULL AND
        "transcript_turn"."writer_generation" IS NULL AND
        "transcript_turn"."sequence" IS NULL AND
        "transcript_turn"."room_name" IS NULL AND
        "transcript_turn"."delivery_state" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "transcript_turn"."contract_version" = 2 AND
        "transcript_turn"."event_id" IS NOT NULL AND
        "transcript_turn"."writer_id" IS NOT NULL AND
        "transcript_turn"."writer_generation" IS NOT NULL AND
        "transcript_turn"."sequence" IS NOT NULL AND
        "transcript_turn"."room_name" IS NOT NULL AND
        "transcript_turn"."started_at" IS NOT NULL AND
        "transcript_turn"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL AND
        "transcript_turn"."text" IS NOT NULL AND
        "transcript_turn"."audio_ms" IS NOT NULL AND
        "transcript_turn"."section" IS NOT NULL AND
        "transcript_turn"."delivery_state" IS NOT NULL
      )

analytics_consent_metadata_check.name: analytics_consent_metadata_check
analytics_consent_metadata_check.value: ("user_settings"."analytics_consent" = 'undecided' AND "user_settings"."analytics_consent_version" IS NULL AND "user_settings"."analytics_consent_source" IS NULL AND "user_settings"."analytics_consent_updated_at" IS NULL AND "user_settings"."analytics_consent_revision" = 0) OR ("user_settings"."analytics_consent" IN ('accepted', 'declined') AND "user_settings"."analytics_consent_version" > 0 AND "user_settings"."analytics_consent_source" IN ('banner', 'settings', 'legacy_decline', 'account_sync') AND "user_settings"."analytics_consent_updated_at" IS NOT NULL AND "user_settings"."analytics_consent_revision" > 0)
